title: The tensor part of normalized semilinear derived-system calculus
statement: For a site C,J with independent universes and a sequence of commutative ring sheaves B with transition maps, use the actual sequence-site systems, ordinary unbounded derived categories and scalar-extension data of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models, def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. SystemTensorReductionModels packages only: one normalized ScalarData for each lower coefficient map, closed tensors and K-flat tensor models on the sequence site and each level, evaluation tensor isomorphisms with their TensorComparisonModel and ordinaryEvaluationTensor normalization, and scalar tensor isomorphisms with ScalarTensorComparisonModel. It contains no internal-Hom evaluation comparison and no cartesianness hypothesis. All fields are parameters; no object is chosen from an unspecified existence proof.
